title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover ten distinct study environments at Brandeis University, from 24-hour student centers to quiet library mezzanines and specialized graduate lounges.

cards.title: Goldfarb Library Level 1
cards.subtitle: Collaborative Hub with Starbucks Access
cards.notes: Utilize large tables for group projects on the main floor. This level offers a casual atmosphere with easy access to the lower-level Starbucks for caffeine breaks.
cards.short_summary: A high-energy collaborative study area on the first floor of the main library.
cards.evidence_claim: Goldfarb 1 offers large study tables for group work and is located near the lower-level Starbucks.
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; Brandeis ID required for entry after certain hours.

cards.title: Farber Mezzanine Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Reservable Collaborative Spaces
cards.notes: Book a room for up to four hours daily. These spaces feature large tables and whiteboards, ideal for intensive group sessions and midterm preparation.
cards.short_summary: Private, reservable rooms equipped with whiteboards for student groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Group study rooms are located on the Farber Mezzanine and can be booked for up to four hours per person per day.
cards.access_notes: Reservations required via the library booking page; limited to 4 hours per day.

cards.title: Shapiro Campus Center Upper Level
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Quiet Zone with Natural Light
cards.notes: Find a quiet desk in the upper-level computer lab. Large windows provide natural light, and the building is accessible 24 hours a day with a student ID.
cards.short_summary: A bright, 24-hour study area located on the top floor of the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shapiro Campus Center (SCC) is accessible by ID card 24 hours a day and features a quiet study space on the upper level.
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 with a valid Brandeis ID card.

cards.title: Gerstenzang Science Library Quiet Area
cards.subtitle: Silent Study in the Science Complex
cards.notes: Head here for focused, silent study. This library provides a more traditional, quiet atmosphere compared to the social buzz of Goldfarb.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated silent study environment within the science library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Leo Gerstenzang Science Library provides a quiet place for study, ideal for exam preparation.
cards.source_title: A grad student's guide to the best study spots at Brandeis
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; check current library schedule for seasonal changes.

cards.title: Mandel Center Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Humanities Hub on the Third Floor
cards.notes: Visit Room 303 for a peaceful reading environment. This space is designed for small meetings and individual study within the humanities center.
cards.short_summary: A quiet reading room located on the third floor of the Mandel Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The third floor of the Mandel Center contains a Reading Room (Room 303) available for community use.
cards.source_title: Academic Spaces | Mandel Center - Brandeis University
cards.access_notes: Generally available during building hours; classrooms in the building are reservable after 6:45 PM.

cards.title: Heller School Breakout Rooms
cards.subtitle: Private Ground-Floor Workspaces
cards.notes: Use these first-come, first-served rooms for private meetings or online classes. Each room is equipped with chargers and a TV for screen sharing.
cards.short_summary: Ground-floor breakout rooms in the Heller-Schneider building for private study.
cards.evidence_claim: Heller School breakout rooms on the ground floor are available on a first-come, first-served basis and feature chargers and TVs.
cards.source_title: On Campus Study Spots - The Heller School
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served for students; public access typically M-F 7 AM-7 PM.

cards.title: Graduate Student Center (Kutz Hall)
cards.subtitle: Full-Service Lounge for Grads
cards.notes: Access computers, printers, and a kitchen with free snacks. This first-floor space in Kutz Hall is a dedicated hub for the graduate community.
cards.short_summary: A comprehensive study and social lounge for graduate students in Kutz Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Graduate Student Center in Kutz Hall offers computers, printers, a kitchen, and free snacks for graduate students.
cards.source_title: A grad student's guide to the best study spots at Brandeis
cards.access_notes: Restricted to graduate students; located on the first floor of Kutz Hall.

cards.title: Peace Room (Usdan Student Center)
cards.subtitle: Quiet Reflection and Dialogue Space
cards.notes: Seek out this vibrant room for quiet reflection or small group dialogue. It is located on the first floor of the Usdan Student Center.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated space for quiet reflection and peacemaking dialogue in Usdan.
cards.evidence_claim: The Peace Room in Usdan is open to students for individual reflection or quiet during business hours.
cards.source_title: Peace Room | Center for Spiritual Life - Brandeis University
cards.access_notes: Open during Usdan business hours; food and drink are not permitted.

cards.title: World Court (Lemberg Academic Center)
cards.subtitle: Open Atrium with International Flair
cards.notes: Study in this two-story open space lined with international flags. It offers a bright, airy environment for individual work between classes.
cards.short_summary: A scenic, flag-lined atrium in the International Business School building.
cards.evidence_claim: The World Court is an open space in the Lemberg Academic Center, typically open M-F 8 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Spaces for Graduate Students | Brandeis University
cards.access_notes: Typically open Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

cards.title: Library Meditation Room
cards.subtitle: Silent Space for Mindfulness
cards.notes: Take a mental break in this room equipped with yoga mats and cushions. It is intended for meditation and finding a moment of peace during long study days.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet room for meditation and prayer within the main library.
cards.evidence_claim: The library's Meditation Room is intended for meditation, prayer, and mindfulness, with mats and cushions available.
cards.source_title: Rooms and Spaces | Library - Brandeis University
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; intended for silent use only.
